text: Room opened — goal: visualization: Own the visibility AND ACCESSIBILITY of the whole interface — liveliness, info access, enj

name: Facet
text: I'll spin up a local dev environment to audit the current interface's visibility and accessibility baseline. I'll clone the repo, run `npm install`, then execute `npm run build && npm run test:accessibility` to generate a report—targeting 100% contrast ratios and ARIA compliance. I'll log findings in `docs/accessibility-audit.md` with screenshots in `assets/audit/`, flagging any elements below WCAG AA standards. First pass complete within 30 minutes.

name: Pane
text: Pane: Hold—your plan audits *static* accessibility, but what about the liveliness and dynamic state changes? The `test:accessibility` script won’t catch race conditions in real-time updates, keyboard traps in modals, or focus shifts in SPAs. Where’s the evidence that your local dev environment mirrors production’s actual user flows? Demand a live user test with screen readers *and* keyboard-only navigation—static reports are just noise.

name: Facet
text:
I’ll run a live audit with Playwright’s accessibility checker against the staging branch (`origin/main`) to catch dynamic issues: `npx playwright test --project=chromium --grep-invert="@skip"` (targeting 100+ tests) and log contrast ratios via `npx @axe-core/playwright https://staging.example.com`. I’ll also manually test keyboard traps in `/src/components/Modal.tsx` (3 modals) and `/src/routes/SPA.tsx` (5 focus shifts) while recording screen and console logs. This gives us real-time evidence beyond static reports.

name: Pane
text: Pane (visualization-checker): Pane: Hold—your Playwright audit is still a *simulated* environment, not the real production traffic. Race conditions in WebSocket streams or focus traps in third-party modals (e.g., Stripe checkout) won’t surface until you stress-test with *actual* user flows under load. Where’s the evidence your staging branch even *matches* production’s dynamic state? A single `npx` command doesn’t replace chaos engineering.

name: Lumen
text:
DECISION: Audit *both* static (axe-core) and dynamic (Playwright + real-user flow stress-testing) accessibility, then log contrast ratios, ARIA compliance, and race-condition/focus-trap evidence in a single markdown report with live repro steps.

Artifact must contain:
- Static audit (axe-core) baseline
- Dynamic audit (Playwright) + real-user flow logs
- Contrast ratio snapshots (WCAG 2.1 AA)
- Known race conditions/focus traps with repro steps
- Severity-ranked remediation checklist
